entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I think I need to return something. I'm just so confused by all this.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, order number 884-512-9003. It's for the VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just not sure what the rules are.

No problem at all, Sarah. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see it here, delivered 21 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. It's just... everything has been a mess. My husband had a sudden medical emergency right after we got it. He had to have surgery, and he was in the hospital for almost two weeks.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope he's doing better now.

He is, thank you. But his military deployment got postponed because of it, and we just won't be using the band at all now. The box isn't even open. I didn't understand the policy on the website... can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. And please, don't worry about the policy. Given the circumstances, I completely understand. Let me just double-check our system for you. One moment.
Okay, I've pulled up our return guidelines here. It looks like you're perfectly fine. All VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Ninety days? Oh, I thought I read something about it being shorter.

Our internal guide is clear on this. Since you received it only 21 days ago, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file as we speak.
Oh, wow. Really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You have no idea how much this helps.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. The least we can do. You should see that email in your inbox within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a swift recovery.
